topic: How is immune homeostasis maintained and regulated?
headline_conclusion: Immune homeostasis is a dynamic, compartmentalized, and individualized feedback process maintained through coordinated tolerance--effector regulation, barrier and microbiota context, exposure and memory history, and recovery trajectories; it cannot be reduced responsibly to a single static universal threshold.

selected_direction.title: A Personal Longitudinal Immune-Homeostasis Atlas with Bounded Human Microphysiological Counterfactual Testing

known_limits: This is an evidence-constrained research proposal, not an empirical immune model or a clinical validation study.
The literature synthesis is targeted and traceable, but it is not a systematic review or meta-analysis.
The proposed human microphysiological tests can only assess bounded directional consistency and cannot establish whole-person causal efficacy.
Any future human-data or clinical use requires ethics, privacy, governance, and domain-expert review.
